Subject: Draft credit calculation (SLA excerpt & proposed amount)

Alex / team —

Following Priya's note, we've run the initial numbers against the committed tier on DEAL-9932. Summary below and attached as a working spreadsheet (credit-calculation-draft.xlsx):

- Contracted monthly committed minutes (baseline): 43,200 minutes (30-day baseline)
- Eligible downtime window verified: 02:42–03:17 UTC on 2026-03-10 -> 35 minutes eligible for review
- Redwood uptime target for this tier: 99.9% (equates to 43.2 minutes maximum downtime per month)
- Calculation approach (per SLA section 4.2, excerpt attached):
  - If monthly downtime > 43.2 minutes: Service Credit = (Downtime Minutes - 43.2) / 43,200 * MonthlyCommittedFee
  - For partial exceedance we prorate to the nearest full minute.

From the telemetry we see total monthly downtime to-date (including maintenance windows) of ~60.5 minutes for March cycle, which places the excess at 17.3 minutes. Based on your committed monthly fee (per contract) the draft credit comes to $1,292.50.

Notes / caveats:
- This is a draft pending final verification against your request and our incident audit logs.
- If you have a different monthly baseline period (billing anchor), call that out and we’ll recalc.
- If you want us to cap the credit at the quarterly invoice, let us know — we’ll apply whatever contractual cap applies.

Attachment: credit-calculation-draft.xlsx (XLSX, 18 KB)

I’ll leave Priya to coordinate next steps; happy to run through the calc over a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
